s1_netrev:
-- Assumption: orders.status codes are not documented in the schema; treating 2=shipped and 3=delivered as fulfilled (excludes cancelled/returned)
SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) AS net_revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s1_netrev_p2:
-- Assumption: orders.status codes are not documented; treating 2=shipped and 3=delivered as fulfilled, which excludes cancelled/returned orders
SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) AS net_revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s1_netrev_p3:
-- Assumption: orders.status codes are not documented; treating 2=shipped and 3=delivered as fulfilled orders; whole period means no date filter
SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) AS net_revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s1_aov:
-- Assumption: fulfilled orders = status IN (2,3) (shipped/delivered); AOV computed on net revenue per order
SELECT AVG(order_total) AS avg_order_value
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.line_total) AS order_total
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.status IN (2, 3)
  GROUP BY o.order_id
) t;
s1_aov_p2:
-- Assumption: fulfilled orders = status IN (2,3) (shipped/delivered); average net revenue per order
SELECT AVG(order_total) AS avg_order_value
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.line_total) AS order_total
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.status IN (2, 3)
  GROUP BY o.order_id
) t;
s1_aov_p3:
-- Assumption: fulfilled orders = status IN (2,3) (shipped/delivered); typical order value = average net revenue per order
SELECT AVG(order_total) AS avg_order_value
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.line_total) AS order_total
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.status IN (2, 3)
  GROUP BY o.order_id
) t;
s1_margin:
-- Assumption: fulfilled orders = status IN (2,3); gross margin = net revenue (line_total) minus product unit_cost * quantity
SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) - SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_cost) AS gross_margin
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s1_active_cust:
-- Assumption: 'active' customers = customers with at least one fulfilled (status IN (2,3): shipped/delivered) order
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_key) AS active_customers
FROM orders o
WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s1_active_p2:
-- Assumption: fulfilled order = status IN (2,3) (shipped/delivered)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_key) AS active_customers
FROM orders o

s1_active_p3:
-- Assumption: 'shipped' interpreted broadly as fulfilled = status IN (2,3) (shipped/delivered)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_key) AS active_customers

s1_gross_rev:
-- Assumption: fulfilled orders = status IN (2,3); gross revenue = quantity * unit_price before discount_rate is applied
SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS gross_revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s1_orders:
-- Assumption: 'shipped or delivered' = status IN (2,3) (status codes not documented in schema)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS shipped_or_delivered_orders
FROM orders o
WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s1_top_customer:
-- Assumption: fulfilled orders = status IN (2,3); spend measured as net revenue (line_total)
SELECT c.customer_id, c.full_name, SUM(oi.line_total) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_key
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.status IN (2, 3)
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 1;
s2_shipping_total:
-- Assumption: fulfilled orders = status IN (2,3) (shipped/delivered); shipping_fee is per-order so summed over distinct orders
SELECT SUM(o.shipping_fee) AS total_shipping_fees
FROM orders o
WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s2_shipping_region:
-- Assumption: fulfilled orders = status IN (2,3); region grouping uses orders.ship_region
SELECT o.ship_region, SUM(o.shipping_fee) AS total_shipping_fees
FROM orders o
WHERE o.status IN (2, 3)
GROUP BY o.ship_region;
s2_rev_and_ship:
-- Assumption: fulfilled orders = status IN (2,3); region = orders.ship_region; shipping computed separately from revenue to avoid double-counting shipping_fee across order lines
WITH rev AS (
  SELECT o.ship_region, SUM(oi.line_total) AS net_revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.status IN (2, 3)
  GROUP BY o.ship_region
),
ship AS (
  SELECT o.ship_region, SUM(o.shipping_fee) AS total_shipping
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.status IN (2, 3)
  GROUP BY o.ship_region
)
SELECT COALESCE(rev.ship_region, ship.ship_region) AS region, rev.net_revenue, ship.total_shipping
FROM rev
FULL OUTER JOIN ship ON rev.ship_region = ship.ship_region;
s2_lines:
-- Assumption: fulfilled orders = status IN (2,3) (shipped/delivered)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_lines
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s2_avg_line_disc:
-- Assumption: fulfilled orders = status IN (2,3); average shipping fee computed per order (shipping_fee is order-level)
SELECT AVG(o.shipping_fee) AS avg_shipping_fee_per_order
FROM orders o
WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s3_refund_total:
SELECT SUM(refund_amount) AS total_refunds
FROM returns;
s3_refund_by_cat:
-- Assumption: returns line-level (order_id, line_number) maps to order_items to determine product category
SELECT p.category, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS total_refunds
FROM returns r
JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id AND r.line_number = oi.line_number
JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key
GROUP BY p.category;
s3_refund_units:
SELECT SUM(return_qty) AS total_units_returned
FROM returns;
s3_refund_rev_by_cat:
-- Assumption: fulfilled orders = status IN (2,3); refunds mapped to category via order_items line join
WITH rev AS (
  SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.line_total) AS net_revenue
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key
  WHERE o.status IN (2, 3)
  GROUP BY p.category
),
ref AS (
  SELECT p.category, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS total_refunds
  FROM returns r
  JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id AND r.line_number = oi.line_number
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key
  GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT COALESCE(rev.category, ref.category) AS category, rev.net_revenue, ref.total_refunds
FROM rev
FULL OUTER JOIN ref ON rev.category = ref.category;
s5_ship_pct_region:
-- Assumption: fulfilled orders = status IN (2,3); region = orders.ship_region; shipping and revenue computed separately to avoid double counting
WITH rev AS (
  SELECT o.ship_region, SUM(oi.line_total) AS net_revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.status IN (2, 3)
  GROUP BY o.ship_region
),
ship AS (
  SELECT o.ship_region, SUM(o.shipping_fee) AS total_shipping
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.status IN (2, 3)
  GROUP BY o.ship_region
)
SELECT COALESCE(rev.ship_region, ship.ship_region) AS region,
       (ship.total_shipping / rev.net_revenue) * 100 AS shipping_pct_of_net_revenue
FROM rev
FULL OUTER JOIN ship ON rev.ship_region = ship.ship_region;
s7_vocab_paidsearch:
-- Assumption: 'paid search' refers to orders.channel (order acquisition channel); exact stored label unknown so matched case-insensitively
SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) AS net_revenue_paid_search
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.status IN (2, 3)
  AND LOWER(o.channel) LIKE '%paid%search%';
s7_vocab_paidsearch_orders:
-- Assumption: 'paid search' refers to orders.channel; fulfilled orders = status IN (2,3); exact stored label unknown so matched case-insensitively
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS paid_search_orders
FROM orders o
WHERE o.status IN (2, 3)
  AND LOWER(o.channel) LIKE '%paid%search%';

SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.line_total) AS net_revenue
FROM order_items oi

s8_rev_2024:
-- Assumption: fulfilled orders = status IN (2,3); calendar year 2024 based on order_ts
SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) AS net_revenue_2024
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status IN (2, 3)
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01';
s8_rev_fy2024:
-- Assumption: fulfilled orders = status IN (2,3); fiscal year 2024 = Feb 1 2024 through Jan 31 2025 (fiscal year starts Feb 1)
SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) AS net_revenue_fy2024
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status IN (2, 3)
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01';
s8_rev_by_month:
-- Assumption: fulfilled orders = status IN (2,3); calendar months of 2024 based on order_ts
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_ts) AS month, SUM(oi.line_total) AS net_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.status IN (2, 3)
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
